title: Sul4urLib
body: > This data pack is a library. > It does nothing on its own and is meant to be used with other data packs that require this data pack to work. Sul4urlib is a data pack library which adds tools to make data pack creation easier. It makes it easier to handle custom GUI, store additional player data, convert from total XP to levels and points and the opposite way, etc. It's meant to be used by my data packs/mods, but any developer can use this data pack/mod as well. ## Documentation Documentation for how to use this data pack will come soon.﻿
